_comment: Corrections to how scripts/merge.mjs parses a Wikipedia infobox gross, keyed by Wikidata id. An entry applies only while the infobox text still equals `text`; if editors change it, the override is ignored and merge prints a warning so the entry can be removed.

Q5681533.title: Haathkadi (1995 film)
Q5681533.reason: Misplaced comma: ₹8.29 crore was parsed as ₹829 crore.

Q10967355.title: Badal (1951 film)
Q10967355.reason: The bracketed inflation-adjusted 2016 figure was parsed instead of the release-era gross.
